ValidationRule.description: Waiting for NDA required fields: Last, First, Suffix, Company, Street, City, Zip
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED( Status ) && TEXT(Status) == 'Waiting for NDA' && (ISBLANK(LastName) || ISBLANK(FirstName) || ISBLANK( Street ) || ISBLANK (State) || ISBLANK ( PostalCode))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are required to request an NDA: Last Name, First Name, Suffix, and Address (Street, State, and Zip)
